name: session-chronicle
description: Sidebar that analyzes your Claude Code usage: now, cost, tips, standup, improve

excludeProjects.title: Excluded projects
excludeProjects.description: Comma-separated project path prefixes to leave out of the analysis (e.g. customer work)

aiModel.title: AI model
aiModel.description: Model for the 詳しく explanation and AI summary. haiku is cheapest; fable consumes usage credits and only runs when you press g.

aiEffort.title: AI effort
aiEffort.description: Thinking effort for those calls. low keeps tokens down.

autoExplain.title: Explain on open
autoExplain.description: Generate the AI explanation as soon as 詳しく opens. Off: press g to generate. Cached answers are always shown.

cacheExplanations.title: Cache explanations
cacheExplanations.description: Keep explanations of Cost/Tips/Improve findings in the plugin store (plain JSON, 40 entries, 14 days) so reopening costs no tokens.
